summary: Environmental Engineer with a BS in Environmental Engineering and hands-on experience across the food manufacturing and medical device industries. Track record of ensuring operational compliance, strengthening environmental sustainability programs, and upholding regulatory requirements in highly controlled industrial settings.

experience.title: Environmental Specialist
bullets: Ensured compliance with environmental regulations (local, federal, company) through timely submission of permits and reports.
Managed sampling, waste handling, and environmental documentation for water, air, and hazardous materials.
Supported successful ISO 14001 and KORE audits and drove continuous improvement in environmental programs.
Optimized waste management processes, reducing costs and risks.
Provided technical training to staff, strengthening safety and sustainability culture.

experience.title: Environmental Engineer
bullets: Led coordination, management, education, planning, and monitoring of the facility's environmental program.
Developed and updated environmental procedures, reports, and plans.
Managed and ensured proper disposal of non-hazardous, regulated, and special waste, including manifesting, transportation, and record keeping.
Managed programs for the identification of waste minimization and pollution prevention opportunities to achieve facility environmental program objectives and goals.

certifications: Water and Wastewater Treatment Operator IV
